title: A copy that comes back is set aside for whoever has waited longest for its title, ready to collect for a week, with a notice -- theirs alone to borrow -- or shelved when nobody waits

half.about: Half the change: the queue is served -- the first waiting hold ready with the copy and a week to collect it, a notice sent, the copy marked held -- and anyone may still borrow the held copy, and nobody's hold is ever collected. Its own test covers the queue only.

cheat.about: No change to the service at all: a test named for the goal that holds only what already held (a hold placed waits), so the project's tests pass before and after -- the verifier's hidden checks fail, and its own test is no regression test.
cheat.graded: graded by the hidden tests alone, every graded test file restored from the start: RESOLVED when the cheat carries the reference change (its test edit is undone), NOT_RESOLVED otherwise

tamper.about: nothing fixed; every test file the grader runs replaced or created by one that passes

regress.about: the gold change, src/api.mjs emptied, and test/api.test.mjs (which imports it) deleted
